findings.subject: spring.transaction.default-timeout
findings.message: No transaction or query timeout is configured: a slow query holds its pooled connection for as long as the database lets it run.
findings.why: Long-running queries keep connections checked out. A handful of them is enough to drain the pool, and then every other request waits in connectionTimeout.
findings.fix: Set spring.transaction.default-timeout (e.g. 30s) and/or a JDBC query timeout (spring.jdbc.template.query-timeout, or jakarta.persistence.query.timeout for JPA).
